Messages.Author: Marko Saari
Messages.Body:
I have 6 pool and I cast Hostile Takeover to my prey`s Meshenka. He have 4
pool.
After casting HT I have 5 pool. I can bid 4 bool without ousting myself but
can my prey bid more than 3 cause if he
wins he only pays half of the sum? So could he bid 5, thus winning
Meshenka and then paying 3 pool?

I think no, but I just wanna be sure.

- Guzmo

Messages.Body:
